The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Isolate the steam heating valve and condensate valve.
Complete maintenance tools set.
Cleaning fluid, manual pullers.
Straight edge, rages.
Small wire brush, filler gauge.
Chain, lifting hock, dial gauge.
Prior to commencing the dismounting.
The following operations must be performed:
Pinch off power supply cable to the motor.
All valves (supply, delivery, steam and condensate) must be closed.
Drain fluid by opening drain plug (use collecting tank)
Let screw pump cool down to ambient temperature.
Dismount motor if need, manometers and manometer lines and take their out.
Dismount protection against accidental contact from the base plate.

Screw off bolts (52) to dismount pumps cover non drive side (4) from pump 
 casing (1) and take gasket (21) out.

Screw off bolts (51) to dismount the cartridge unit pump from the pump casing 
 (1) and then take it out.
Remove gasket (21) and "O" ring (29).

items:
With draw coupling half from the driving spindle (12) use 
 manual puller.
Remove key (41) from the driving spindle (12).

Remove cir clip (35) and spacer bush (16) from the driving 
 spindle (12).

Screw off bolts (54) to dismount bearing cover (5) from pump 
 cover drive side (3).

Pull bearing cover (5) over the spindle (12) by using manual

 in the bearing cover (5)
Dismount circlip (37) from the bearing cover (5)

Dismount groove ball bearing (34) from the bearing cover (5) 
 by using manual puller and take care to avoid any damages to the stationary

Dismount supporting washer (36)

Dismount stationary seal ring (83) and "O" ring from the 
 bearing cover (5).

Dismount rotating part of mechanical seal(83) which 
 consisting of rotating seal ring, casing, retaining profile washer, spring and 
 valve spring plate over the driving spindle (12)
Dismount spacer ring (80) and junk ring (81).

sections.text: Dismounting of the set of Spindle

items:
Screw off bolts (55) and dismount pump cover drive side 
 (3) over the driving spindle (12).
Remove gasket (24) and clean sealing surface.

With draw set of spindle consisting of drive spindle (12) 
 and two idler spindle (13) with the balance bushes (8) from the drive spindle 
 (12).

sections.text:
Inspection and Changing of 
all part for the Pump

items: Check all gaskets (21) & (22) & (24) and change damage gasket.
Check "O" ring (29) and change it if need.
Check all circlips (35) & (37) and change it if need
Check the deep groove ball bearing (34) and change it if need
Clean and repair the bearing house

Check the stationary ring, rotating ring and "O" ring for mechanical seal (83) 
 and change damage ring.

Check the pump casing insert and spindle for mechanical wear and chemical 
 corrosion and renew it if there is big clearance between spindles and insert.

Check the two halfs of the coupling and its flexible parts and change it if 
 need.
Clean very well all parts of pump.
Assembly every parts in reverse sequence of dismounting.

After finishing the assembly of the pump, make alignment the pump with motor 
 and rotating by hand from the coupling.
Re- grease the ball bearing from the lubricating nipple.
Return work permit and put it in a portion.
Chick the direction of rotation before starting.
Open the inlet and outlet valves.
Open tracing steam for heating the pump.
Check the alignment of the pump after heating.
Check the vibration and noisy
Check the temperature of bearing
Check the discharge pressure

Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document out lines the major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
 every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.
The pump function is provided with the boilers required fuel and with required 
 pressure.
Technical Specification :
Model no. | SNH 440 ER46
Manufacture | Allweiler Tushaco India
Capacity | 426 L/Min
Pressure | 24.5 Bar
Pump Speed | 1450 RPM
Power | 37 kw,380v,50Hz
No. of spindle | 3(one drive and two idler)
Shaft seal | Mechanical seal
Bearing type | 6308 C3z ball bearing
The first draft initiated by eng. Hesham Abd-Elmalek, tested by eng. Gamal El 
 Eseily, reviewed by eng. Sobhey 
 Abdel Haleem, approved by eng. Mohamed Sayed Abd El Ghaffar: general director 
 of Al-Arish Power Station.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman 
 EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general director and 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of the pump.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Isolate the steam heating valve and condensate valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tools set.
Cleaning fluid, manual pullers.
Straight edge, rages.
Small wire brush, filler gauge.
Chain, lifting hock, dial gauge.
Work to be Carried Out
Dismounting of Screw Pump
Prior to commencing the dismounting.
The following operations must be performed:
Pinch off power supply cable to the motor.
All valves (supply, delivery, steam and condensate) must be closed.
Drain fluid by opening drain plug (use collecting tank)
Let screw pump cool down to ambient temperature.
Dismount motor if need, manometers and manometer lines and take their out.
Dismount protection against accidental contact from the base plate.
Dismount of 
the Cartridge Unit
Screw off bolts (52) to dismount pumps cover non drive side (4) from pump 
 casing (1) and take gasket (21) out.
Screw off bolts (51) to dismount the cartridge unit pump from the pump casing 
 (1) and then take it out.
Remove gasket (21) and "O" ring (29).
Dismounting of the Bearing Cover and Bearing
With draw coupling half from the driving spindle (12) use 
 manual puller.
Remove key (41) from the driving spindle (12).
Remove cir clip (35) and spacer bush (16) from the driving 
 spindle (12).
Screw off bolts (54) to dismount bearing cover (5) from pump 
 cover drive side (3).
Pull bearing cover (5) over the spindle (12) by using manual 
 puller. Then take gasket (22) = Note: stationary seal ring (83) remain 
 in the bearing cover (5)
Dismount circlip (37) from the bearing cover (5)
Dismount groove ball bearing (34) from the bearing cover (5) 
 by using manual puller and take care to avoid any damages to the stationary 
 seal ring (83)
Dismount supporting washer (36)
Dismount of the Mechanical Seal
Dismount stationary seal ring (83) and "O" ring from the 
 bearing cover (5).
Dismount rotating part of mechanical seal(83) which 
 consisting of rotating seal ring, casing, retaining profile washer, spring and 
 valve spring plate over the driving spindle (12)
Dismount spacer ring (80) and junk ring (81).
Dismounting of the set of Spindle
Screw off bolts (55) and dismount pump cover drive side 
 (3) over the driving spindle (12).
Remove gasket (24) and clean sealing surface.
With draw set of spindle consisting of drive spindle (12) 
 and two idler spindle (13) with the balance bushes (8) from the drive spindle 
 (12).
Inspection and Changing of 
all part for the Pump
Check all gaskets (21) & (22) & (24) and change damage gasket.
Check "O" ring (29) and change it if need.
Check all circlips (35) & (37) and change it if need
Check the deep groove ball bearing (34) and change it if need
Clean and repair the bearing house
Check the stationary ring, rotating ring and "O" ring for mechanical seal (83) 
 and change damage ring.
Check the pump casing insert and spindle for mechanical wear and chemical 
 corrosion and renew it if there is big clearance between spindles and insert.
Check the two halfs of the coupling and its flexible parts and change it if 
 need.
Assembly 
of the Pump
Clean very well all parts of pump.
Assembly every parts in reverse sequence of dismounting.
After finishing the assembly of the pump, make alignment the pump with motor 
 and rotating by hand from the coupling.
Re- grease the ball bearing from the lubricating nipple.
Return work permit and put it in a portion.
Starting 
of Pump
Chick the direction of rotation before starting.
Open the inlet and outlet valves.
Open tracing steam for heating the pump.
Check the alignment of the pump after heating.
During 
Operation
Check the vibration and noisy
Check the temperature of bearing
Check the discharge pressure
